 Ipswich Town have made a strong start to the Premier League season - and that's led boffins at stats-bible Opta to make a bold prediction for where they'll finish in the final table.
 The Blues sit tenth in the league after their first seven games, with nine points thus far and some generally impressive displays.
 READ MORE: Assessing Abdoul - How summer signing Ouattara has caught the eye at Portman Road 
 They're defying pre-season predictions which saw them tipped to be immediately relegated back to the Championship.
 And the analyst team at Opta - the stats-bible for football - believe they'll continue to exceed expectations.
 Their latest predicted Premier League table for the current season has Town finishing in the lofty heights of 14th, well clear of the drop zone.
 READ MORE: Odds slashed on Man City being relegated after potential punishment leaked 
 Indeed, they are predicted to finish above both fellow newly-promoted sides Hull City and Coventry City, plus the likes of Crystal Palace and Friday's foes Nottingham Forest.
 Opta believe that Coventry, Fulham and Sunderland will be relegated, with Arsenal retaining their Premier League crown just ahead of Manchester City - who face a huge punishment for financial breaches, yet to be determined.
 Town are tipped to finish 14th in the top tier (Image: Ross Halls) 
 The full predicted Premier League 2026/27 table after seven games is... 
 1: Arsenal - 79 pts
 2: Man City - 78 pts
 3: Brighton - 66 pts
 4: Liverpool - 63 pts
 5: Chelsea - 60 pts
 6: Aston Villa - 55 pts
 7: Brentford - 52 pts
 8: Man Utd - 51 pts
 9: Leeds Utd - 51 pts
 10: Everton - 50 pts
 11: Bournemouth - 48 pts
 12: Newcastle - 48 pts
 13: Spurs - 46 pts
 14: Ipswich Town - 45 pts 
 15: Hull City - 44 pts
 16: Crystal Palace - 44 pts
 17: Nottingham Forest - 43 pts
 18: Coventry City - 41 pts
 19: Fulham - 40 pts
 20: Sunderland - 40 pts
 What do you think? Could Town finish 14th? Or even higher?
